stubs.service: Web Bluetooth / physical ToothPaste dongle (ESP32-S3 BLE HID)
stubs.how: out/ui-capture/ble-stub.js, loaded before the app bundle, replaces navigator.bluetooth with a fake already-paired device 'ToothPaste Desk' (MAC f4122fa8c3d1) exposing the ToothPaste GATT service; it answers the app's auth packet with a protobuf CHALLENGE ResponsePacket (firmware 2.0.0) and acknowledges later writes with KEEPALIVE packets, so 'Connect to Device' ends up in the connected/ready state.

The two Google Fonts stylesheet URLs in the built index.html/CSS are rewritten to /ui-capture-fonts/fonts.css, generated from @fontsource packages (Ubuntu Sans Mono, Roboto Mono, Libre Barcode 39 Extended, Inter, Open Sans, Ubuntu Mono) installed in .ui-capture/fonts-pkg.

stubs.service: GitHub Releases firmware download (api.github.com, used by web/scripts/fetch-firmware.mjs at build time)
stubs.how: .ui-capture/fetch-firmware-offline.sh downloads the real v2.0.0 ToothPasteFirmware_*.bin assets via github.com and writes the same public/firmware/manifest.json the build script would; vite build is then run directly.

notes: ToothPaste web app (React 19 + Vite PWA), built statically with node 20.19.5 from mise.toml. Rebuild: .ui-capture/build.sh (vite build -> copies dist to .ui-capture/out, generates seed data, local fonts, injects stub + seeder into index.html; web/ sources unchanged). There is no backend: all user data lives in the browser (localStorage + encrypted IndexedDB 'ToothPasteDB'). On first load, out/ui-capture/seed.js writes out/ui-capture/seed-data.json into that storage using the app's own format (AES-GCM, passwordless-mode key, same as EncryptedStorage.saveBase64), then imports the app entry. Seed data (generated by .ui-capture/seed/gen-seed.mjs, which runs the app's own DuckyscriptParser for ast/estimatedTime): quickstart already dismissed, storage in passwordless mode (auto-unlocks, so no login), ~40 saved Duckyscripts spread over ~7 months (BIOS/LUKS/BitLocker passwords, admin console logins, CTF one-liners, templates, a few imported/half-finished scripts with parse errors), and ECDH pairing keys for 3 paired devices. Main areas: Navbar (Connect to Device button - click it to connect to the stubbed 'ToothPaste Desk' dongle; Live Capture / Paste / About tabs, Update and Quick Start overlays), Live Capture view (default; keyboard/mouse/touchpad/media controls), Paste view (Text tab for bulk paste, Duckyscript tab with the saved script library and editor), About page.
